grammar_title: 复合动名词(被动式 being done / 完成式 having done / 否定式与逻辑主语 complex -ing)
source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 4 Grammar in Use:复合动名词。句子地道、围绕灾难求生主题,答案唯一(干扰项为语态/时间/否定上不成立的-ing形式)。零术语、应用型填空。

points.point: 被动式动名词 being done(动作的承受者)
points.overview: 当 -ing 形式的逻辑主语是动作的承受者(被…)时,介词后或作主语/宾语用被动式动名词 being done。

points.point: 完成式动名词 having done(先于主句的动作)
points.overview: 当 -ing 表示的动作主动发生、且明显早于主句动作完成时,用完成式 having done。

points.point: 否定式 not doing 与带逻辑主语的复合动名词 sb doing
points.overview: 在 -ing 前加 not 构成否定式;-ing 前可带自己的逻辑主语(代词/名词)构成复合结构。

questions.stem: The little boy was terrified of ____ under the broken wall.
questions.explanation: 男孩是被埋的承受者,介词 of 后用被动式动名词 being buried;burying 表主动埋别人,与句意不符。

questions.stem: No one enjoys ____ alone in the dark during a long power cut.
questions.explanation: 人是被独自留下的对象,用被动式 being left;leaving 表主动离开,意思相反。

questions.stem: The trapped miners had little hope of ____ before their air ran out.
questions.explanation: 矿工是被营救的对象,of 后用被动式 being rescued。

questions.stem: These old houses are in real danger of ____ down in the next quake.
questions.explanation: 房子是被震倒的承受者,用被动式 being knocked down。

questions.stem: The villagers were afraid of ____ by the fast-rising flood water.
questions.explanation: 村民是被困的对象,of 后用被动式 being trapped。

questions.stem: The injured man was carried out without ____ by anyone in the crowd.
questions.explanation: 他是被注意的对象,without 后用被动式 being noticed。

questions.stem: She hated ____ in the crowded shelter with no news for hours.
questions.explanation: 她是被滞留的对象,用被动式 being kept;keeping 表主动保留某物,与句意不符。

questions.stem: The villagers still remember ____ of the coming typhoon by the radio.
questions.explanation: 村民是被警告的对象,用被动式 being warned。

questions.stem: After ____ from the rubble at last, the child cried with joy.
questions.explanation: 孩子是被拉出的对象,after 后用被动式 being pulled。

questions.stem: The frightened dog was scared of ____ behind in the flooded house.
questions.explanation: 狗是被留下的对象,of 后用被动式 being left。

questions.stem: A good shelter saves people from ____ by falling stones.
questions.explanation: 人是被砸的对象,save sb from 后用被动式 being hit。

questions.stem: The old bridge was at risk of ____ away by the powerful flood.
questions.explanation: 桥是被冲走的对象,of 后用被动式 being washed away。

questions.stem: Nobody likes ____ woken by a loud alarm in the middle of the night.
questions.explanation: 人是被吵醒的对象,用被动式 being woken。

questions.stem: The climbers were in danger of ____ by a sudden avalanche.
questions.explanation: 登山者是被掩埋的对象,of 后用被动式 being buried。

questions.stem: He escaped from the building without ____ by the falling bricks.
questions.explanation: 他是被砸的对象,without 后用被动式 being struck。

questions.stem: The low town could not avoid ____ by the huge waves of the storm.
questions.explanation: 城镇是被淹的对象,avoid 后用被动式 being flooded。

questions.stem: Important papers should be kept dry to stop them from ____ in the flood.
questions.explanation: 文件是被毁坏的对象,stop...from 后用被动式 being ruined。

questions.stem: The little cat hid under the bed to keep from ____ during the quake.
questions.explanation: 猫是被看见的对象,keep from 后用被动式 being seen。

questions.stem: Several survivors spoke of ____ for hours before any help arrived.
questions.explanation: 幸存者是被困的对象,of 后用被动式 being trapped。

questions.stem: The little girl was proud of ____ to safety by the brave firefighter.
questions.explanation: 女孩是被抱到安全处的对象,of 后用被动式 being carried。

questions.stem: ____ everything they owned in the flood, the family had to start again.
questions.explanation: 他们主动失去财物且早于主句,用完成式 Having lost;被动式与句意不符。

questions.stem: ____ the residents in good time, the police moved on to the next village.
questions.explanation: 警察先警告了居民再前往,主动且在先,用 Having warned。

questions.stem: The rescuer was proud of ____ ten people the day before.
questions.explanation: 救援者主动救人且发生在'前一天',of 后用完成式 having saved。

questions.stem: ____ through several earthquakes, the old man stayed calm this time.
questions.explanation: 老人经历过多次地震在先,用主动完成式 Having lived through。

questions.stem: ____ their homes to the fire, the villagers were still grateful to be alive.
questions.explanation: 村民先失去家园,主动且在先,用 Having lost。

questions.stem: She thanked the soldiers for ____ her family well before the dam broke.
questions.explanation: 士兵主动警告且在大坝决堤'之前',for 后用完成式 having warned。

questions.stem: ____ a strong shelter earlier, they felt safe when the typhoon came.
questions.explanation: 他们更早就建好了避难所,主动且在先,用 Having built。

questions.stem: ____ everyone out of the building, the firefighters finally took a rest.
questions.explanation: 消防员先把人带出再休息,主动在先,用 Having led。

questions.stem: The captain was praised for ____ all the passengers before the ship sank.
questions.explanation: 船长主动救人且在沉船'之前',for 后用完成式 having saved。

questions.stem: ____ the danger before others, he was able to warn the whole street.
questions.explanation: 他先看出危险才去示警,主动在先,用 Having seen。

questions.stem: ____ many lives in past floods, the river was finally controlled by a new dam.
questions.explanation: 河流过去夺去许多生命在先,主动用 Having taken。

questions.stem: After ____ for help for hours, the trapped workers heard the rescue team.
questions.explanation: 他们主动呼救数小时在先,after 后用主动完成式 having shouted;shout 不及物,无被动。

questions.stem: ____ all our water on the first day, we had nothing left to drink later.
questions.explanation: 我们先用光了水,主动在先,用 Having used。

questions.stem: He felt sorry for ____ the warning, which had cost the family their home.
questions.explanation: 他主动忽视了警告在先,for 后用完成式 having ignored。

questions.stem: ____ a kit ready well in advance, they faced the typhoon quite calmly.
questions.explanation: 他们事先备好了求生包,主动在先,用 Having prepared。

questions.stem: The town was proud of ____ thousands of people during the great flood.
questions.explanation: 小镇主动收容了数千人,of 后用完成式 having sheltered。

questions.stem: ____ from the avalanche just in time, the skiers hugged each other.
questions.explanation: 滑雪者先逃出雪崩再相拥,主动在先;escape 不及物,无被动,用 Having escaped。

questions.stem: She remembered ____ the gas before leaving, so she felt relieved.
questions.explanation: 她主动关了燃气且在离开'之前',用完成式 having turned off。

questions.stem: ____ the children to safety first, the teacher went back for the others.
questions.explanation: 老师先把孩子带到安全处再返回,主动在先,用 Having taken。

questions.stem: The volunteers were thanked for ____ so much food before the roads closed.
questions.explanation: 志愿者主动送来食物且在封路'之前',for 后用完成式 having brought。

questions.stem: ____ what was happening, the children kept playing in the street.
questions.explanation: 与主句同时发生、表否定原因,用否定式 Not knowing。

questions.stem: ____ where to hide, the tourists ran in all directions during the quake.
questions.explanation: 不知道往哪躲(同时、否定原因),用 Not knowing。

questions.stem: The driver apologised for ____ the warning signs on the flooded road.
questions.explanation: for 后接否定式动名词 not noticing,表'没注意到'。

questions.stem: She blamed herself for ____ the family earlier about the storm.
questions.explanation: for 后用否定式动名词 not warning,表'没早点提醒'。

questions.stem: ____ the evacuation order, some people stayed and put themselves in danger.
questions.explanation: 没听从撤离令(否定原因),用否定式 Not following。

questions.stem: He felt guilty about ____ enough water before the shops all closed.
questions.explanation: about 后用否定式动名词 not buying,表'没买够'。

questions.stem: ____ for two days, the trapped hikers grew weak and cold.
questions.explanation: '两天没吃东西'早于主句且需完成意味,用否定完成式 Not having eaten。

questions.stem: The town suffered badly for ____ ready for such a strong typhoon.
questions.explanation: for 后用否定式动名词 not being ready,表'没做好准备'。

questions.stem: ____ the gas before he left the house, the man caused a small fire.
questions.explanation: '没关燃气'是起火原因,用否定式 Not turning off。

questions.stem: I really regret ____ to the weather warning on the radio that night.
questions.explanation: regret 后用否定式动名词 not listening,表'后悔没听'。

questions.stem: There is no point in us ____ in such a dangerous area any longer.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后接动名词,逻辑主语 us + staying。

questions.stem: Nothing could stop the river ____ its banks during the heavy storm.
questions.explanation: stop sth doing 结构,逻辑主语 the river + breaking。

questions.stem: We were grateful for the soldiers ____ us food and clean water.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后接动名词,逻辑主语 the soldiers + bringing。

questions.stem: I don't mind the neighbours ____ in our shelter for the night.
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词,逻辑主语 the neighbours + staying。

questions.stem: The loud alarm prevented the family from ____ asleep in the smoke.
questions.explanation: prevent...from 后接动名词,逻辑主语 the family + staying。

questions.stem: Everyone was surprised at the firefighters ____ the fire so quickly.
questions.explanation: at 后接动名词,逻辑主语 the firefighters + putting out。

questions.stem: There is little chance of the storm ____ before midnight tonight.
questions.explanation: of 后接动名词,逻辑主语 the storm + passing。

questions.stem: We could not imagine the water ____ so fast inside the house.
questions.explanation: imagine 后接动名词,逻辑主语 the water + rising;rise 不及物,无被动。

questions.stem: It is no use the children ____ when the lift has already stopped.
questions.explanation: It is no use doing 结构,逻辑主语 the children + shouting。

questions.stem: The whole rescue depended on the helicopter ____ before dark.
questions.explanation: depend on 后接动名词,逻辑主语 the helicopter + arriving;arrive 不及物,无被动。
